pilot_control.launch_fidelity: CORRECTED: the baked image defaults ARE byte-equivalent to the observed serve-argv. Main inspected the exact digest with `skopeo inspect --override-os linux --override-arch amd64 --config`: config.Entrypoint=['/opt/deploy-preflight.sh'] and config.Cmd EXACTLY EQUALS the observed serve-argv.json list, INCLUDING --enable-cache-report. So arguments=[] is the observed image-default-equivalent launch (the preflight ENTRYPOINT runs the baked Cmd) and reproduces the run faithfully. My earlier claim that the baked default omitted --enable-cache-report was WRONG: it relied on a public code-search of the build repo, which proves nothing about the built image bytes; the OCI config is authoritative. See Main's minimal OCI-config proof in the mirror.
